text:
nora: Quick sync - I want a short "optimize heuristics" page + a tiny sample corpus and a smoke bench so we can catch quant regressions. Who wants the PR?

javier: I can assemble the corpus CSV. Any guidance on token-length mix?

nora: Prefer: 50% short (<64), 35% mid (64-512), 15% long (512-1500). Include 5 embedding examples and 3 multi-turn chats.

rachel: I'll write the playbook copy. Plan: brief guidance on batching heuristic, KV prefetch recommendations, quant profile caveats, and the smoke test specs.

tom: I'll add an SDK quickstart snippet and the bench runner (bench.py --smoke). Keep the snippet tiny: `await client.generate({model: "redwood-opt-3b-quant", input: prompt, batch_size: 8, kv_prefetch: true})`.

javier: Uploaded draft CSV gist: https://gist.github.com/javier/opt-sample (WIP). Columns: id,role,content,tag,expected_tokens.

nora: Copy the CSV into docs/examples so the build can fetch it. Path: docs/optimize/examples/sample-corpus.csv and add README with Apache-2.0 header and contributor notes.
rachel: Snippet for quant section: `quant_profile: dtype: qint8 prefer_gpu_kernels: true fallback: float16 notes: "run quality evals before rollout"`. Call out q2_k caveats.

tom: Bench harness note: use `--smoke` to run 30 short prompts and assert no crash and mean latency < 120ms on short prompts (adjust per runner). We'll add platform buckets.

nora: PR checklist: playbook md, sample-corpus.csv + README, examples/bench/bench.py, SDK snippet update. Tag reviewers javier, rachel, tom. Link back here when opened.

docs-bot: New PR opened by javier: #6310 "optimize: heuristics playbook + sample corpus + smoke bench". CI pending.

javier: One CI question: license header? I'll add Apache-2.0 to README and bench.py.
rachel: I found a small mismatch when running qint8 locally: faster but small quality diffs on arithmetic prompts. Adding note: "run the eval harness on canonical prompts".

tom: CI lint passed but bench smoke failed on linux-quant. Increasing threshold for q2_k and adding runner-specific buckets.

docs-bot: All checks passed. PR #6310 merged by nora.

nora: Post-merge: 1) add link from optimize landing, 2) announce in #eng-ml, 3) add release note blurb. I'll handle 1 and 3.

javier: I'll post the announcement after we confirm sample-corpus metrics in prod infra.
rachel: Filing an internal ticket to run monthly bench on the corpus to track drift.

nora: Thanks team! Closing thread."
